About the General Session & Exhibition

IADR will host its 105th General Session, in conjunction with the 7th Annual Meeting of the IADR Asia/Pacific Region, in Melbourne, Australia, on June 23-26, 2027. The event will feature oral and poster presentations, Hands-on Workshops, Lunch & Learning Sessions, Keynote Addresses, and Symposia presented by experts from across the world. Don’t miss this opportunity to present your research, deepen your knowledge, and meet new colleagues in your field.
